title: Technical Plan: Inventory and Warehouse v2.01 Overview

purpose.en: The goal, the two modules and the limits of the 2.01 improvement of Inventory and Warehouse. Everything is previewed and approved before it is built.
purpose.id: Tujuan, dua modul, dan batasan perbaikan 2.01 untuk Inventory dan Warehouse. Semuanya di-preview dan disetujui dulu sebelum dibangun.

keywords: technical plan, rencana teknis, inventory, warehouse, gudang, v2.01, improvement, preview, mockup

steps.en: Inventory answers what, how much, what value and whose stock. Warehouse answers where it is and how it is handled physically.
steps.id: Inventory menjawab apa, berapa, nilainya berapa, dan milik siapa. Warehouse menjawab di mana barangnya dan bagaimana penanganan fisiknya.

steps.en: Transfer and stock count documents belong to Inventory. The field work (tasks, scans, counting) belongs to Warehouse.
steps.id: Dokumen Transfer dan opname dimiliki Inventory. Pekerjaan lapangan (tugas, scan, hitung) dimiliki Warehouse.

steps.en: Not changed: Stock Card, Stock Summary and Warehouse Map. They are already correct; any improvement is shown as a preview first.
steps.id: Tidak diubah: Stock Card, Stock Summary, dan Warehouse Map. Ketiganya sudah benar; perbaikan apa pun ditunjukkan sebagai preview dulu.

steps.en: New in 2.01: batch master, stock owner, batch status, one Average per item, QC by sampling with an URGENT path, short delivery requests, subcontract and customer material flows.
steps.id: Baru di 2.01: master batch, pemilik stok, status batch, satu Average per item, QC sampling dengan jalur URGENT, permintaan kirim kekurangan, alur subkon dan material titipan customer.

steps.en: Booking starts when product costing has calculated, so purchasing can act before the customer order exists.
steps.id: Booking dimulai sejak product costing sudah menghitung, supaya pembelian bisa bergerak sebelum customer order ada.

steps.en: Built on the dummy databases (ddt) until release. Nothing is written to the live databases during this work.
steps.id: Dibangun di database dummy (ddt) sampai rilis. Tidak ada yang ditulis ke database live selama pekerjaan ini.

fields.label: Inventory
fields.en: Documents, quantities, values, owners, batches, quality status and reports.
fields.id: Dokumen, qty, nilai, pemilik, batch, status mutu, dan laporan.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.en: Map, areas, bins, receiving, putaway, pick list, labels, scanning and count tasks.
fields.id: Peta, area, bin, receiving, putaway, pick list, label, scan, dan tugas hitung.

fields.label: Frozen zone
fields.en: Inquiry Product, ProDev and ProCost are only read, never changed.
fields.id: Inquiry Product, ProDev, dan ProCost hanya dibaca, tidak pernah diubah.

fields.label: Preview rule
fields.en: Every new screen or change is drawn as an image, checked, and approved by the user before any code.
fields.id: Setiap layar baru atau perubahan digambar sebagai gambar, diperiksa, dan disetujui user sebelum ada kode.

title: Technical Plan: Menu Split Inventory and Warehouse

purpose.en: How the menu is organised now and how it would be split into two modules. A preview image shows both side by side; it waits for approval.
purpose.id: Bagaimana menu tersusun sekarang dan bagaimana akan dibagi menjadi dua modul. Gambar preview menampilkan keduanya berdampingan; menunggu persetujuan.

keywords: menu, modul inventory, modul warehouse, pemisahan menu, label qr, scan center, laporan stok

steps.en: Today there is one Inventory module. Warehouse is only a sub-group inside it, so value reports, labels and scanning are mixed together.
steps.id: Sekarang hanya ada satu modul Inventory. Warehouse hanya sub-grup di dalamnya, sehingga laporan nilai, label, dan scan tercampur.

steps.en: Proposed Inventory module: Stock Documents per class, Subcontract, Customer Material, Batch and Quality, Reservation link, Valuation and Period, Reports, Related Master Data.
steps.id: Usulan modul Inventory: Stock Documents per kelas, Subcontract, Customer Material, Batch dan Quality, tautan Reservation, Valuation dan Period, Reports, Related Master Data.

steps.en: Proposed Warehouse module: Map and Monitor, Receiving and Putaway, Pick List, Transfer, Count, Labels and Scan, Tools, Task Board, Setup.
steps.id: Usulan modul Warehouse: Map dan Monitor, Receiving dan Putaway, Pick List, Transfer, Count, Labels dan Scan, Tools, Task Board, Setup.

steps.en: Value reports (Stock Card all items, Recapitulation, Summary, Opname, Loss and Gain, In Inspection) move to Inventory Reports. Their content does not change.
steps.id: Laporan nilai (Stock Card semua item, Recapitulation, Summary, Opname, Loss dan Gain, In Inspection) pindah ke Inventory Reports. Isinya tidak berubah.

steps.en: Labels and QR codes and the Scan Center move to Warehouse because they are field work.
steps.id: Label dan QR serta Scan Center pindah ke Warehouse karena merupakan pekerjaan lapangan.

steps.en: Moving menu items is a deviation, so it is shown as an image and built only after the user approves it.
steps.id: Memindahkan item menu adalah deviasi, jadi ditunjukkan sebagai gambar dan dibangun hanya setelah user menyetujuinya.

fields.label: Stay as they are
fields.en: Stock In, Out, Return, Adjustment per class, Warehouse Map, Stack Monitor, Stock by Location, Buildings, Storage Areas, Bins.
fields.id: Stock In, Out, Return, Adjustment per kelas, Warehouse Map, Stack Monitor, Stock by Location, Buildings, Storage Areas, Bins.

fields.label: Moves to Inventory
fields.en: Stock Transfer and its approval, and the value reports.
fields.id: Stock Transfer beserta approval-nya, dan laporan nilai.

fields.label: Moves to Warehouse
fields.en: Print labels, label history, Scan Center, and the Warehouse and Location master.
fields.id: Cetak label, riwayat label, Scan Center, dan master Warehouse dan Location.

fields.label: New screens
fields.en: Each new screen carries its phase (F1 to F6) and its own preview.
fields.id: Setiap layar baru membawa fasenya (F1 sampai F6) dan previewnya sendiri.

title: Technical Plan: Stock Model (Ledger, Balance, Status, Owner)

purpose.en: How stock is modelled, following SAP, Odoo, ERPNext, Dynamics 365 and NetSuite: a movement ledger, balances as a result, status and owner.
purpose.id: Bagaimana stok dimodelkan, mengikuti SAP, Odoo, ERPNext, Dynamics 365, dan NetSuite: buku pergerakan, saldo sebagai hasil, status, dan pemilik.

keywords: model stok, ledger, kartu stok, saldo, status stok, pemilik stok, batch, stock ledger entry, quant

steps.en: Every movement is a ledger line with a source and a destination, including virtual places such as vendor, customer, loss, production and transit.
steps.id: Setiap pergerakan adalah baris buku dengan asal dan tujuan, termasuk tempat virtual seperti vendor, customer, loss, produksi, dan transit.

steps.en: The balance is the result of the ledger. A mistake is corrected by an opposite document, never by editing a line.
steps.id: Saldo adalah hasil buku. Kesalahan dikoreksi dengan dokumen lawan, tidak pernah dengan mengubah baris.

steps.en: Quantity stays per bin through the existing chained stock card. Value and Average move to one chain per item.
steps.id: Qty tetap per bin lewat kartu stok berantai yang ada. Nilai dan Average pindah ke satu rantai per item.

steps.en: Status lives on the batch: Quarantine, Conditional, Released, Rejected, Blocked. Each status says whether the stock counts as Available and may be allocated.
steps.id: Status melekat pada batch: Quarantine, Conditional, Released, Rejected, Blocked. Tiap status menentukan apakah stok dihitung Available dan boleh dialokasikan.

steps.en: Owner is Company, Customer or Supplier. Stock of another owner is shown in the warehouse but never valued or journalled.
steps.id: Pemilik adalah Company, Customer, atau Supplier. Stok milik pihak lain tampil di gudang tetapi tidak pernah dinilai atau dijurnal.

steps.en: Dates: entry date and posting date are separate, and a closed period refuses new postings.
steps.id: Tanggal: tanggal input dan tanggal posting terpisah, dan periode yang sudah ditutup menolak posting baru.

fields.label: Odoo
fields.en: A stock move has lines per lot or location; reservation picks quants by a removal strategy.
fields.id: Stock move punya baris per lot atau lokasi; reservasi memilih quant menurut strategi ambil.

fields.label: ERPNext
fields.en: The stock ledger entry holds quantity, incoming rate, balance value and valuation rate for each movement.
fields.id: Stock ledger entry memuat qty, incoming rate, balance value, dan valuation rate tiap pergerakan.

fields.label: SAP
fields.en: A movement type decides the quantity update and the accounts; a quant is the stock of one material in one bin.
fields.id: Tipe pergerakan menentukan update qty dan akun; quant adalah stok satu material di satu bin.

fields.label: NetSuite
fields.en: Inventory status has availability flags, so quantity on hand can exist while available quantity is zero.
fields.id: Inventory status punya bendera ketersediaan, sehingga qty on hand bisa ada sementara qty available nol.

fields.label: Dynamics 365
fields.en: Physical and financial updates are separate, with statuses Received and Purchased, Deducted and Sold.
fields.id: Update fisik dan finansial terpisah, dengan status Received dan Purchased, Deducted dan Sold.

fields.label: Our choice
fields.en: Keep the existing stock card, add the batch, owner, status and the per-item value chain.
fields.id: Pertahankan kartu stok yang ada, tambah batch, pemilik, status, dan rantai nilai per item.

title: Technical Plan: Catalogue of Stock Movements

purpose.en: Every way stock moves, with the effect on quantity, value and journal. Based on SAP movement types, ERPNext stock entry purposes and NetSuite transactions.
purpose.id: Semua cara stok bergerak, dengan efeknya pada qty, nilai, dan jurnal. Berdasarkan tipe pergerakan SAP, purpose stock entry ERPNext, dan transaksi NetSuite.

keywords: tipe pergerakan, movement type, katalog pergerakan, goods receipt, issue, transfer, adjustment, scrap, subkon, titipan

steps.en: Receipt from a purchase order adds stock at purchase price plus landed cost. Journal: debit Inventory, credit GR/IR.
steps.id: Penerimaan dari PO menambah stok pada harga beli ditambah landed cost. Jurnal: debit Persediaan, kredit GR/IR.

steps.en: Issue to production and delivery to customer take stock at the item Average. Journals: debit WIP or Cost of Goods Sold, credit Inventory.
steps.id: Issue ke produksi dan pengiriman ke customer mengambil stok pada Average item. Jurnal: debit WIP atau HPP, kredit Persediaan.

steps.en: Transfer, sending to a subcontractor and changing a batch status do not change value and make no journal.
steps.id: Transfer, kirim ke subkon, dan ubah status batch tidak mengubah nilai dan tidak membuat jurnal.

steps.en: Customer material is stock owned by the customer: no value and no journal. Subcontract results add value of the material sent plus the service cost.
steps.id: Material titipan customer adalah stok milik customer: tanpa nilai dan tanpa jurnal. Hasil subkon menambah nilai bahan yang dikirim ditambah ongkos jasa.

steps.en: Adjustment, scrap and short delivery correction use their own accounts so they can be reported separately.
steps.id: Adjustment, scrap, dan koreksi kurang kirim memakai akun sendiri sehingga bisa dilaporkan terpisah.

steps.en: Reservation and allocation are not movements. They are recorded apart from the stock ledger.
steps.id: Reservasi dan alokasi bukan pergerakan. Keduanya dicatat terpisah dari buku stok.

fields.label: SAP 101 and 261
fields.en: Goods receipt for a purchase order and goods issue for an order.
fields.id: Penerimaan barang untuk PO dan pengeluaran barang untuk order.

fields.label: SAP 301 and 311
fields.en: Transfer between plants and between storage locations in one step.
fields.id: Transfer antar plant dan antar storage location dalam satu langkah.

fields.label: SAP 541 and 543
fields.en: Material to the vendor (subcontract) and consumption of components when the result is received.
fields.id: Material ke vendor (subkon) dan konsumsi komponen saat hasil diterima.

fields.label: SAP 551 and 701
fields.en: Scrapping and inventory differences.
fields.id: Scrap dan selisih persediaan.

fields.label: ERPNext purposes
fields.en: Material Receipt, Issue, Transfer, Transfer for Manufacture, Manufacture, Repack, Send to Subcontractor.
fields.id: Material Receipt, Issue, Transfer, Transfer for Manufacture, Manufacture, Repack, Send to Subcontractor.

fields.label: NetSuite
fields.en: Item Receipt, Inventory Transfer without value gain or loss, Inventory Adjustment for quantity and value, Inventory Status Change.
fields.id: Item Receipt, Inventory Transfer tanpa untung rugi nilai, Inventory Adjustment untuk qty dan nilai, Inventory Status Change.

title: Technical Plan: Workflow, Receiving and Quality

purpose.en: The inbound workflow: receiving, sampling QC, the URGENT path straight to production, putaway, and short delivery found later.
purpose.id: Alur kerja masuk: receiving, QC sampling, jalur URGENT langsung ke produksi, putaway, dan kurang kirim yang baru ketahuan belakangan.

keywords: alur kerja, receiving, penerimaan, qc sampling, urgent, dock to line, putaway, kurang kirim, conditional, alokasi bin

steps.en: Receiving at the dock: count, weigh, label the pallet and take a sample according to the sampling plan.
steps.id: Receiving di dok: hitung, timbang, beri label pallet, dan ambil sampel sesuai rencana sampling.

steps.en: Normal path: quick tests at the dock decide the lot (Released or Rejected), then the receipt is posted and the pallet is put away.
steps.id: Jalur normal: uji cepat di dok memutuskan lot (Released atau Rejected), lalu penerimaan diposting dan pallet disimpan.

steps.en: URGENT path: an authorised person marks it with a reason and a work order. It is posted at once as Conditional and goes straight to the machine.
steps.id: Jalur URGENT: pihak berwenang menandainya dengan alasan dan work order. Langsung diposting sebagai Conditional dan dibawa ke mesin.

steps.en: Sampling goes on in parallel for an URGENT receipt. A rejection traces forward to work orders and finished goods, holds them and raises a supplier claim.
steps.id: Sampling berjalan paralel untuk penerimaan URGENT. Penolakan menelusur maju ke work order dan barang jadi, menahannya, dan membuat klaim supplier.

steps.en: Putaway suggests a bin from the area rules (mixing, pick order, capacity, stack); the officer confirms by scanning the pallet and then the bin.
steps.id: Putaway menyarankan bin dari aturan area (mixing, pick order, kapasitas, stack); petugas mengonfirmasi dengan scan pallet lalu bin.

steps.en: Short delivery: if output plus standard waste is still more than the material issued, the quantity was short from the start; the shortfall is requested.
steps.id: Kurang kirim: bila output ditambah waste standar masih lebih dari material yang dikeluarkan, qty sudah kurang sejak awal; kekurangannya diminta.

fields.label: Sampling plan
fields.en: Sample size by lot size with tightened, normal, reduced or skip intensity. All values are settings.
fields.id: Ukuran sampel menurut jumlah lot dengan intensitas ketat, normal, ringan, atau lewati. Semua nilai adalah pengaturan.

fields.label: Odoo receipts
fields.en: One, two or three steps; in three steps goods pass a quality area before they reach stock.
fields.id: Satu, dua, atau tiga langkah; pada tiga langkah barang melewati area mutu sebelum masuk stok.

fields.label: SAP EWM
fields.en: Goods are received into an interim bin, then putaway tasks move them to the destination bin.
fields.id: Barang diterima ke interim bin, lalu task putaway memindahkannya ke bin tujuan.

fields.label: Dynamics 365
fields.en: Receiving creates work with a Pick line from the dock and a Put line to the location.
fields.id: Receiving membuat work dengan baris Pick dari dok dan baris Put ke lokasi.

fields.label: Shortfall
fields.en: (Output + standard waste) minus quantity issued. Waste above standard is a usage variance, not a claim.
fields.id: (Output + waste standar) dikurangi qty yang dikeluarkan. Waste di atas standar adalah varians pemakaian, bukan klaim.

fields.label: If the supplier refuses
fields.en: After 7 days the PO line is closed at the received quantity and a debit note or invoice deduction is asked.
fields.id: Setelah 7 hari baris PO ditutup di qty terima dan diminta debit note atau potongan tagihan.

title: Technical Plan: Workflow, Booking, Picking, Transfer and Count

purpose.en: The outbound and internal workflows: booking from costing, pick list allocation, the map layer, transfer, subcontracting and stock count.
purpose.id: Alur kerja keluar dan internal: booking dari costing, alokasi pick list, lapisan peta, transfer, subkon, dan opname.

keywords: booking, pre-booking, pick list, alokasi, peta gudang, transfer, in transit, subkon, opname, hitung, kunci bin

steps.en: Booking ladder: pre-booking when ProCost is published, then quotation, customer order draft, and a hard lock when the customer order is confirmed.
steps.id: Tangga booking: pre-booking saat ProCost terbit, lalu quotation, customer order draft, dan kunci keras saat customer order dikonfirmasi.

steps.en: Pre-booking never reduces Available. It shows demand and shortage early so purchasing can act. One chain per inquiry, never counted twice.
steps.id: Pre-booking tidak pernah mengurangi Available. Ia menampilkan kebutuhan dan kekurangan lebih awal supaya pembelian bisa bergerak. Satu rantai per inquiry, tidak dihitung dua kali.

steps.en: Pick list: from the confirmed booking the engine allocates pallets, batches and bins by the area rule (FIFO or FEFO), grain and certification.
steps.id: Pick list: dari booking yang dikonfirmasi, mesin mengalokasikan pallet, batch, dan bin menurut aturan area (FIFO atau FEFO), serat, dan sertifikasi.

steps.en: The Warehouse Map stays unchanged. Choosing a pick or putaway task only adds an optional allocation layer on top.
steps.id: Warehouse Map tetap tidak berubah. Memilih tugas pick atau putaway hanya menambah lapisan alokasi opsional di atasnya.

steps.en: Transfer in two steps for distant warehouses: shipped goes to In Transit, received goes to the new place; a difference becomes a discrepancy.
steps.id: Transfer dua langkah untuk gudang jauh: dikirim masuk In Transit, diterima masuk ke tempat baru; selisih menjadi discrepancy.

steps.en: Stock count: scheduled per area, the bin is locked while counted, differences wait for approval and are posted as a numbered adjustment.
steps.id: Opname: dijadwalkan per area, bin dikunci selama dihitung, selisih menunggu persetujuan dan diposting sebagai penyesuaian bernomor.

fields.label: Subcontract
fields.en: Send Material refers to the subcontract purchase order; the vendor is a virtual location owned by the company.
fields.id: Send Material merujuk ke PO subkon; vendor adalah lokasi virtual milik perusahaan.

fields.label: Odoo removal strategies
fields.en: FIFO, LIFO, FEFO, closest location and least packages decide which stock is taken.
fields.id: FIFO, LIFO, FEFO, lokasi terdekat, dan paket paling sedikit menentukan stok mana yang diambil.

fields.label: Dynamics 365 reservation
fields.en: A reservation hierarchy decides the order of dimensions; batches with the earliest expiry are reserved first.
fields.id: Hierarki reservasi menentukan urutan dimensi; batch dengan kedaluwarsa paling awal dicadangkan lebih dulu.

fields.label: Hot job
fields.en: A rule-based priority; a takeover needs the operations manager and is logged, and the order that lost stock is notified.
fields.id: Prioritas berbasis aturan; pengambilalihan butuh Ops Manager dan dicatat, dan order yang kehilangan stok diberi tahu.

fields.label: Count rules
fields.en: Odoo compares on-hand with counted quantity and posts the difference as a stock move; cycle counts follow ABC classes.
fields.id: Odoo membandingkan qty tercatat dengan qty hitung dan memposting selisih sebagai stock move; cycle count mengikuti kelas ABC.

fields.label: Cancelled after issue
fields.en: Unused material returns to free stock; printed or consumed material is written off or billed by contract.
fields.id: Material tak terpakai kembali ke stok bebas; yang tercetak atau terpakai dihapus buku atau ditagih sesuai kontrak.

title: Technical Plan: Data Flow Between Modules

purpose.en: Which module sends which data to which module, and which journals are created, following the perpetual inventory pattern of ERPNext and SAP.
purpose.id: Modul mana mengirim data apa ke modul mana, dan jurnal apa yang dibuat, mengikuti pola persediaan perpetual ERPNext dan SAP.

keywords: aliran data, data flow, procurement, accounting, jurnal, gr/ir, booking, production, delivery, hpp

steps.en: Procurement to Inventory: the purchase receipt posts stock and, when URGENT, is allowed to post before the quality result.
steps.id: Procurement ke Inventory: penerimaan pembelian memposting stok dan, bila URGENT, boleh diposting sebelum hasil mutu.

steps.en: Inventory to Accounting: every movement with a value creates its journal; the stock ledger is reconciled to the general ledger every day.
steps.id: Inventory ke Accounting: setiap pergerakan bernilai membuat jurnalnya; buku stok direkonsiliasi ke buku besar tiap hari.

steps.en: Supplier invoice to Accounting: debit GR/IR, credit Accounts Payable. This is the financial date; the receipt is the physical date.
steps.id: Invoice supplier ke Accounting: debit GR/IR, kredit Hutang Usaha. Ini tanggal finansial; penerimaan adalah tanggal fisik.

steps.en: Production: issue debits Work in Progress and credits Inventory; output debits Finished Goods and credits Work in Progress.
steps.id: Produksi: issue mendebit WIP dan mengkredit Persediaan; hasil mendebit Barang Jadi dan mengkredit WIP.

steps.en: Sales and Planning: booking reads quantity and size from costing and layout only; prices stay secret on the costing side.
steps.id: Sales dan Planning: booking membaca qty dan ukuran dari costing dan layout saja; harga tetap rahasia di sisi costing.

steps.en: Warehouse to Inventory: the scan evidence (quantity, bin, batch, pallet) is the basis for posting. Warehouse never calculates value.
steps.id: Warehouse ke Inventory: bukti scan (qty, bin, batch, pallet) menjadi dasar posting. Warehouse tidak pernah menghitung nilai.

fields.label: ERPNext
fields.en: Purchase Receipt: debit Stock In Hand, credit Stock Received But Not Billed. Delivery Note: debit COGS, credit Stock In Hand.
fields.id: Purchase Receipt: debit Stock In Hand, kredit Stock Received But Not Billed. Delivery Note: debit COGS, kredit Stock In Hand.

fields.label: SAP
fields.en: Movement 101 debits stock and credits GR/IR; movement 201 credits stock and debits the cost account.
fields.id: Pergerakan 101 mendebit stok dan mengkredit GR/IR; pergerakan 201 mengkredit stok dan mendebit akun biaya.

fields.label: Booking to Warehouse
fields.en: Needs per material become pick lists; Available and Reserved come back from Inventory as one source for raw material and finished goods.
fields.id: Kebutuhan per bahan menjadi pick list; Available dan Reserved kembali dari Inventory sebagai satu sumber untuk bahan baku dan barang jadi.

fields.label: Customer invoice
fields.en: Delivery posts cost of goods sold; the sales invoice is a separate entry.
fields.id: Pengiriman memposting HPP; invoice penjualan adalah jurnal terpisah.

fields.label: Reports
fields.en: Stock Card and Stock Summary read the same ledger and must stay identical before and after the change.
fields.id: Stock Card dan Stock Summary membaca buku yang sama dan harus tetap identik sebelum dan sesudah perubahan.

title: Technical Plan: Rules and Formulas

purpose.en: The rules and formulas behind valuation, material need, short delivery and area rules. Every limit is a setting the user can change.
purpose.id: Aturan dan rumus di balik valuasi, kebutuhan bahan, kurang kirim, dan aturan area. Setiap batas adalah pengaturan yang bisa diubah user.

keywords: rumus, average, moving average, kebutuhan lembar, ups, waste, kurang kirim, landed cost, aturan

steps.en: Average is a running average per item for the whole company. An issue never changes the average. A quantity of zero forces the value to zero.
steps.id: Average adalah rata-rata berjalan per item untuk seluruh perusahaan. Issue tidak pernah mengubah average. Qty nol memaksa nilai nol.

steps.en: Opening balance moves to the per-item chain without a journal: opening Average equals total value divided by total quantity of all bins.
steps.id: Saldo awal pindah ke rantai per item tanpa jurnal: Average awal sama dengan total nilai dibagi total qty semua bin.

steps.en: A late landed cost goes to the quantity still on hand; the part already issued goes to a landed cost variance account, closed to cost of goods sold at period end.
steps.id: Landed cost terlambat masuk ke qty yang masih ada; bagian yang sudah keluar masuk akun selisih landed cost, ditutup ke HPP di akhir periode.

steps.en: A back-dated document is inserted in order and later rows are recalculated. One stacked correcting journal is made; old journals stay unchanged.
steps.id: Dokumen bertanggal mundur disisipkan berurutan dan baris sesudahnya dihitung ulang. Dibuat satu jurnal koreksi bersusun; jurnal lama tidak berubah.

steps.en: Sheets needed come from the layout: quantity divided by ups, rounded up, times (1 + waste percent), plus make ready sheets of each process.
steps.id: Lembar dibutuhkan berasal dari layout: qty dibagi ups, dibulatkan ke atas, dikali (1 + persen waste), ditambah lembar make ready tiap proses.

steps.en: LIFO is not used for the books (not allowed by PSAK 14). FIFO is postponed. Negative stock is refused.
steps.id: LIFO tidak dipakai untuk pembukuan (tidak diperbolehkan PSAK 14). FIFO ditunda. Stok minus ditolak.

fields.label: Average after receipt
fields.en: (old quantity x old average + received quantity x received price) divided by (old quantity + received quantity).
fields.id: (qty lama x average lama + qty masuk x harga masuk) dibagi (qty lama + qty masuk).

fields.label: Price rise example
fields.en: 1,000 kg at 15,000 then 500 kg at 16,500 gives 15,500; then 600 kg at 18,000 after issuing 800 kg gives 16,653.85.
fields.id: 1.000 kg @15.000 lalu 500 kg @16.500 menjadi 15.500; lalu 600 kg @18.000 setelah issue 800 kg menjadi 16.653,85.

fields.label: Weight of a sheet
fields.en: Length in m x width in m x gsm gives grams, for example 0.79 x 1.09 x 300 = 258.3 g.
fields.id: Panjang m x lebar m x gsm menghasilkan gram, misalnya 0,79 x 1,09 x 300 = 258,3 g.

fields.label: Area rules
fields.en: Mixing (one item per bin, mixed items, one batch per bin), pick order (FIFO or FEFO), count every N days.
fields.id: Mixing (satu item per bin, campur item, satu batch per bin), pick order (FIFO atau FEFO), hitung tiap N hari.

fields.label: Starting settings
fields.en: QC escalation 4 hours and deadline 8 working hours, stale booking warning 7 days and release 30 days, dead stock 365 days.
fields.id: Eskalasi QC 4 jam dan tenggat 8 jam kerja, peringatan booking basi 7 hari dan lepas 30 hari, dead stock 365 hari.

fields.label: Shortage tolerance
fields.en: Follows the purchase order receipt tolerance that already exists on the receipt line.
fields.id: Mengikuti toleransi penerimaan PO yang sudah ada pada baris penerimaan.

title: Technical Plan: Tables and Data

purpose.en: The tables and columns that are new or changed. Rules: bigint auto number keys, English names, no foreign keys across databases.
purpose.id: Tabel dan kolom yang baru atau berubah. Aturan: kunci bigint auto number, nama English, tanpa foreign key lintas database.

keywords: tabel, database, skema, inv_batch, inv_item_valuation, wh_zone, wh_task, pick list, owner, batch_id

steps.en: New batch master with batch number, supplier lot, dates, quality status, certification, food grade, grain direction and certificate of analysis.
steps.id: Master batch baru berisi nomor batch, lot supplier, tanggal, status mutu, sertifikasi, food grade, arah serat, dan sertifikat analisis.

steps.en: Stock cards, document lines and pallets get a batch column and an owner type and owner id. The old lot text stays until all readers have moved.
steps.id: Kartu stok, baris dokumen, dan pallet mendapat kolom batch serta tipe dan id pemilik. Teks lot lama tetap sampai semua pembaca berpindah.

steps.en: A per-item valuation chain holds total quantity, value and Average in date order across all bins.
steps.id: Rantai nilai per item menyimpan qty total, nilai, dan Average berurutan tanggal lintas semua bin.

steps.en: Areas get virtual and rules columns, plus four new types: WIP, Subcontractor, In Transit, Loss. Pallets link to a batch.
steps.id: Area mendapat kolom virtual dan aturan, ditambah empat jenis baru: WIP, Subkon, In Transit, Loss. Pallet ditautkan ke batch.

steps.en: Later phases add sampling plan and decision tables, urgent columns on the receipt line, shortage request, subcontract issue, tasks, pick list and tool register.
steps.id: Fase berikutnya menambah tabel rencana sampling dan keputusan, kolom urgent pada baris penerimaan, permintaan kekurangan, kirim subkon, tugas, pick list, dan register alat.

steps.en: Booking gets a chain key, a stage from B0 to B4 and a hold until date. Existing data is migrated by commands that can be checked first.
steps.id: Booking mendapat kunci rantai, tahap B0 sampai B4, dan tanggal hold. Data lama dimigrasi oleh perintah yang bisa diperiksa dulu.

fields.label: Batch backfill
fields.en: One batch per item and lot from the stock cards and pallets; empty lots become NO-LOT. Safe to run twice.
fields.id: Satu batch per item dan lot dari kartu stok dan pallet; lot kosong menjadi NO-LOT. Aman dijalankan dua kali.

fields.label: Per-item cutover
fields.en: A check run shows the totals first; the real run writes one opening row per item and creates no journal.
fields.id: Run pemeriksaan menampilkan total dulu; run sebenarnya menulis satu baris awal per item dan tidak membuat jurnal.

fields.label: Where it runs
fields.en: Dummy databases first. The live databases are changed only at release, after the check run is reviewed.
fields.id: Database dummy dulu. Database live diubah hanya saat rilis, setelah run pemeriksaan ditinjau.

fields.label: Tests
fields.en: Same item in two bins costs the same; transfer keeps Average; Stock Card and Stock Summary stay identical.
fields.id: Item yang sama di dua bin berbiaya sama; transfer menjaga Average; Stock Card dan Stock Summary tetap identik.

title: Technical Plan: Preview Mockups and Approval Status

purpose.en: The preview images for 2.01 and whether each is approved. Nothing is built before its preview is approved.
purpose.id: Gambar preview untuk 2.01 dan apakah masing-masing sudah disetujui. Tidak ada yang dibangun sebelum previewnya disetujui.

keywords: preview, mockup, gambar, persetujuan, stock card, stock summary, warehouse map, batch, putaway, pick list

steps.en: Stock Card and Stock Summary use the real screenshots of the existing reports. They are not changed.
steps.id: Stock Card dan Stock Summary memakai tangkapan layar asli laporan yang ada. Keduanya tidak diubah.

steps.en: The Warehouse Map is the approved map image. Only an optional allocation layer is previewed; it needs approval.
steps.id: Warehouse Map adalah gambar peta yang disetujui. Hanya lapisan alokasi opsional yang dipreview; perlu persetujuan.

steps.en: The menu split, the batch grid and form, the batch field in Stock In, and the area types are waiting for approval. The three area rules are approved.
steps.id: Pemisahan menu, grid dan form batch, field batch di Stock In, dan jenis area menunggu persetujuan. Tiga aturan area sudah disetujui.

steps.en: Receiving and Putaway, and the Pick List, are previewed for phases 2 and 3 and wait for approval.
steps.id: Receiving dan Putaway, serta Pick List, dipreview untuk fase 2 dan 3 dan menunggu persetujuan.

steps.en: Sample numbers in every preview must chain and agree with each other; a mismatch is a defect and the image is redrawn.
steps.id: Angka contoh di setiap preview harus bersambung dan sesuai satu sama lain; ketidaksesuaian adalah cacat dan gambar digambar ulang.

steps.en: Still to preview before their phase: URGENT receiving and QC screens, shortage request, pre-booking, subcontract, customer material, transfer in transit, count lock, valuation screens, tool register, task board.
steps.id: Masih harus dipreview sebelum fasenya: penerimaan URGENT dan layar QC, permintaan kekurangan, pre-booking, subkon, material titipan customer, transfer in transit, kunci hitung, layar nilai, register alat, papan tugas.

fields.label: Not changed
fields.en: Stock Card, Stock Summary, Warehouse Map.
fields.id: Stock Card, Stock Summary, Warehouse Map.

fields.label: Approved
fields.en: The three area rules: mixing, pick order, count every N days.
fields.id: Tiga aturan area: mixing, pick order, hitung tiap N hari.

fields.label: Waiting for approval
fields.en: Menu split, batch grid and form, Stock In batch field, new area types, Receiving and Putaway, Pick List, map allocation layer.
fields.id: Pemisahan menu, grid dan form batch, field batch Stock In, jenis area baru, Receiving dan Putaway, Pick List, lapisan alokasi peta.

fields.label: Coverage map
fields.en: One image lists every aspect, its phase, and whether a preview exists.
fields.id: Satu gambar mendaftar setiap aspek, fasenya, dan apakah previewnya ada.

title: Technical Plan: Phases

purpose.en: The order of work in six phases. Each step is one commit, with its Help topic, test numbers and a reviewed preview.
purpose.id: Urutan kerja dalam enam fase. Tiap langkah adalah satu commit, dengan topik Help, angka uji, dan preview yang sudah ditinjau.

keywords: fase, phase, jadwal, urutan kerja, f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, f6

steps.en: Phase 1 Foundation: batch master, owner, status, one Average per item, area types and area rules.
steps.id: Fase 1 Fondasi: master batch, pemilik, status, satu Average per item, jenis area, dan aturan area.

steps.en: Phase 2 Quality and receiving: sampling, URGENT, dock to line, Receiving, Putaway and short delivery requests.
steps.id: Fase 2 Mutu dan penerimaan: sampling, URGENT, dock to line, Receiving, Putaway, dan permintaan kirim kekurangan.

steps.en: Phase 3 Booking: pre-booking from costing, substitution, pick list and one Available source for finished goods.
steps.id: Fase 3 Booking: pre-booking dari costing, substitusi, pick list, dan satu sumber Available untuk barang jadi.

steps.en: Phase 4 Subcontract, customer material and count: send material, stock at vendor, customer-owned stock, In Transit, bin lock.
steps.id: Fase 4 Subkon, titipan customer, dan opname: kirim bahan, stok di vendor, stok milik customer, In Transit, kunci bin.

steps.en: Phase 5 Value: landed cost, GR/IR, daily reconciliation, correcting journals and provision for obsolete stock.
steps.id: Fase 5 Nilai: landed cost, GR/IR, rekonsiliasi harian, jurnal koreksi, dan penyisihan persediaan usang.

steps.en: Phase 6 Refinement: hot job, stale booking, dies and plates, task board and further reports.
steps.id: Fase 6 Penyempurnaan: hot job, booking basi, die dan plat, papan tugas, dan laporan lanjutan.

fields.label: Step S0
fields.en: Settle how the tests run against the dummy databases and record a baseline of the existing inventory tests.
fields.id: Tentukan cara uji berjalan terhadap database dummy dan catat baseline uji inventory yang ada.

fields.label: Steps S1 to S5
fields.en: Schema, batch backfill, per-item Average engine, cutover command, settings and area types.
fields.id: Skema, backfill batch, mesin Average per item, perintah peralihan, pengaturan, dan jenis area.

fields.label: Steps S6 to S8
fields.en: Screens after approval, Help and menu, then new dummy data and the full test run.
fields.id: Layar setelah persetujuan, Help dan menu, lalu data dummy baru dan uji penuh.

fields.label: Release
fields.en: Migrations and commands reach the live databases only at release, after a reviewed check run.
fields.id: Migrasi dan perintah sampai ke database live hanya saat rilis, setelah run pemeriksaan ditinjau.

title: Technical Plan: References

purpose.en: The products and documents this plan is based on, and where it deliberately differs from them.
purpose.id: Produk dan dokumen yang menjadi dasar rencana ini, dan di mana rencana ini sengaja berbeda dari mereka.

keywords: referensi, rujukan, sap, odoo, erpnext, dynamics 365, netsuite, stock moving, workflow, data flow

steps.en: Stock model and movements: Odoo stock moves, ERPNext stock ledger and stock entries, SAP movement types and quants, NetSuite inventory detail, Dynamics 365 inventory transactions.
steps.id: Model stok dan pergerakan: stock move Odoo, stock ledger dan stock entry ERPNext, tipe pergerakan dan quant SAP, inventory detail NetSuite, inventory transaction Dynamics 365.

steps.en: Workflows: Odoo one, two and three step receipts, SAP EWM tasks and warehouse orders, Dynamics 365 work and location status, ERPNext putaway rules.
steps.id: Alur kerja: receipt satu, dua, tiga langkah Odoo, task dan warehouse order SAP EWM, work dan status lokasi Dynamics 365, putaway rule ERPNext.

steps.en: Data flow and valuation: ERPNext perpetual inventory entries, SAP GR/IR, Dynamics 365 physical and financial updates and weighted average.
steps.id: Aliran data dan valuasi: jurnal perpetual inventory ERPNext, GR/IR SAP, update fisik dan finansial serta weighted average Dynamics 365.

steps.en: Special cases: Odoo and SAP subcontracting, SAP special stock for consignment, NetSuite inventory status.
steps.id: Kasus khusus: subkon Odoo dan SAP, special stock SAP untuk konsinyasi, inventory status NetSuite.

steps.en: Official pages were summarised by a reading tool and not verified inside the products. Third party pages are only supporting.
steps.id: Halaman resmi diringkas oleh alat baca dan tidak diverifikasi di dalam produknya. Halaman pihak ketiga hanya pendukung.

steps.en: The full list with links and quality tags is in the references document in the project docs.
steps.id: Daftar lengkap dengan tautan dan penanda kualitas ada di dokumen rujukan pada docs proyek.

fields.label: Where we differ
fields.en: No layered warehouse orders; the officer confirms suggestions. Quality does not block the URGENT path.
fields.id: Tanpa warehouse order berlapis; petugas mengonfirmasi usulan. Mutu tidak menahan jalur URGENT.

fields.label: Average style
fields.en: Running Average per item, not the periodic average with closing used by Dynamics 365.
fields.id: Average berjalan per item, bukan average periodik dengan penutupan seperti Dynamics 365.

fields.label: Our own patterns
fields.en: Conditional status, dock to line and short delivery detection are our adaptations, not standard features.
fields.id: Status Conditional, dock to line, dan deteksi kurang kirim adalah adaptasi kita, bukan fitur baku.
